name: Sky Unveiled
summary:
Most of us live under skies washed out by city lights. Sky Unveiled gives you back the night.

Pick your city from over 34,000 and any date and time. You stand in a quiet meadow, a tent behind you, under the sky as it really is from that place: the Milky Way, the Moon in its true phase, all seven planets and the 9,000 or so stars your eyes could see on a truly dark night. Watch the sun set, then turn the light pollution down to pristine and see what the city has been hiding.

Your own star-party host
Point
